labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Code that catches AssertionError from FileSystemStorage.delete() with an empty name will no longer catch the new ValueError.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Code catching AssertionError from attach_alternative() or attach() with invalid arguments will break because these now raise ValueError.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: assertHTMLEqual now treats attributes differently, so existing test assertions may start failing.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Tests that fail to load now always match test --tag, which changes which tests run and can alter test suite results.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: lookup_needs_distinct() is renamed to lookup_spawns_duplicates(), so code calling the old name will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: HttpRequest.get_raw_uri() is removed, so any code calling it will raise AttributeError and must switch to build_absolute_uri().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The object argument of ModelAdmin.log_addition/log_change/log_deletion is renamed to obj, which breaks keyword callers.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Feed elements with no content now render as self-closing tags, which changes feed output that consumers may parse.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: NodeList.render() no longer converts node output to a string, so custom nodes returning non-string values can break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: where_class and the where_class argument are removed, so code relying on them will fail and must construct WhereNode directly.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The filter_clause argument of Query.add_filter() is replaced by filter_lhs and filter_rhs, which breaks existing callers.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: CsrfViewMiddleware switches to a new request.META key, which breaks custom code that depends on the old CSRF tracking attributes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: TRANSLATOR_COMMENT_MARK moves to a new module, so imports from django.template.base will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The real_apps argument of ProjectState.__init__() must now be a set, so callers passing other types will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: RadioSelect and CheckboxSelectMultiple markup changes to div tags, which can break custom CSS, JavaScript, or tests and may require template overrides.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: floatformat always returns localized output regardless of USE_L10N, which changes rendered output for existing templates.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The USE_L10N default changes to True, which changes formatting across projects that did not set it explicitly.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: django.utils.timezone.utc now aliases datetime.timezone.utc, which can change behavior for code relying on the old implementation.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The minimum asgiref version rises from 3.3.2 to 3.4.1, which requires dependency upgrades in some environments.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Use of pytz time zones is deprecated but still works, so this produces only warnings at this release.
